messages:
rhea: Wrapped interview with Pinecrest this morning. Recording + raw transcript at https://drive.redwood.ai/pinecrest. Need: public quote, short social clip, webinar slot mention, captions (EN/JP), final legal sign-off, and lead routing.

omar: Nice! They volunteered a line about cost "cut in half" and a performance blurb. Legal will probably ask for softened language.

jin: Ops: can we tag leads from the asset as `case-study-high` and route to AE Priya? Also want utm params for the webinar invite.

legal-bot: Checklist: NDA present, release form uploaded. Recommend removing any internal IDs, timestamps, and absolute p99 numbers. Use rounded phrasing for public quote (e.g., "about 50% lower costs"). Final public quote requires a signed release using customer-release-v2.

rhea: Understood. I'll draft two public-safe quote options and send them to the customer for brief sign-off. Jin, please confirm asset distribution tags and landing page template.

jin: Confirmed. Routing: tag `case-study-high`, assign to Priya, and set demo priority to high-touch. UTM example: ?utm_campaign=pinecrest_case&utm_source=twitter&utm_medium=social. Will add pixel and test the flow.

omar: For the webinar, product wants the deep-dive on 2026-04-28. Can marketing produce a single slide with a safe stat and a short demo clip?

rhea: Yes. Deliverables: one slide with paraphrased stat, 30s hero clip for socials, 3x 15s webinar snippets, EN/JP captions. ETA: clips by EOD tomorrow.

legal-bot: If customer insists on exact percentages publicly, we need an additional signed telemetry disclosure. Prefer paraphrased quote.

omar: I'll make the clips and upload to Drive. Quick check: can we quote them as "reduced inference costs by ~50%"?

rhea: Send that phrasing as the public option and a verbatim internal version for internal docs. Ask them to sign the public release.

jin: Pixel + HubSpot flow will be in place by EOD. I'll run a routing test and post results here.

omar: Clips uploaded: https://drive.redwood.ai/pinecrest/assets (hero_30s.mp4, webinar_15s_1.mp4, webinar_15s_2.mp4, webinar_15s_3.mp4). Adding EN captions; JP captions pending vendor.

legal-bot: Received signed release? Pending. Attach redlined transcript to the release form and tag legal for final review.

rhea: Sent the two quote options to Pinecrest; asking for approval within 48 hours. BCC'd legal.

jin: Routing test complete  all good. Demo assign to Priya works. Pixel firing and UTMs captured.

omar: Pinecrest replied: approved the paraphrased public quote and signed the release. Uploading signed PDF to Drive.

legal-bot: Final legal check passed. Transcript redlines attached and approved. Legal marking green. 

rhea: Embargo lift set for 2026-05-05 10:00 PT. Ops - please schedule landing + social at that time.

jin: Scheduled. Landing page publish and social queue will trigger at embargo time. Assignments routed.

omar: Great work team. I'll monitor inbound demo activity post-launch.

rhea: Closing loop: capture webinar registrants and route hot leads to Priya for outreach. Thanks everyone.
